Get U SPORTS hockey pbp

Source: R/hockey_pbp.R
hockey_pbp.Rd

Get U SPORTS hockey pbp

Usage

hockey_pbp(gender, year = c())

Arguments

gender

Gender of athletes "m" or "w"

year

The season(s) of interest.

Value

A tibble.

Examples

hockey_pbp("m",2018)
#> # A tibble: 45,874 × 21
#>    player        time  period event     description     result save  save_player
